about.description:
This feedstock packages the C++ library `librealsense` (including the
`realsense2-gl` GLSL extension module), the Python library `pyrealsense2`,
and `realsense-viewer`. The `realsense-viewer` package contains the graphical
tools `realsense-viewer`, `rs-depth-quality` and `rs-rosbag-inspector`; the
command-line tools (`rs-enumerate-devices`, `rs-fw-update`, ...) stay in
`librealsense`. The packages are built enabling the `FORCE_RSUSB_BACKEND`
CMake option, and they are available for all Linux and macOS platforms
supported by conda-forge, including `linux-aarch64` for Nvidia Jetson boards.
CUDA-enabled packages should be selected automatically on CUDA-capable
platforms. Use `librealsense=*=*cuda*` to force a CUDA build or
`librealsense=*=*cpu*` to force a CPU-only build.
about.license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause
about.license_family: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause
about.summary: Cross-platform library for Intel® RealSense™ depth and tracking cameras.

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: librealsense
  version: "2.59.2"
  # Order of priority:
  # CUDA (+200)
  # CUDA with arm-variant=tegra (+150)
  # CPU (+0)
  # See https://github.com/conda-forge/librealsense-feedstock/issues/41
  build_number: 0
  build_prefix: ${{ "cuda" ~ (cuda_compiler_version | version_to_buildstring) if cuda_compiler_version != "None" else "cpu" }}

recipe:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a41a1533795c582ea12ba652ac6fe7cb97eed08fe9c91ba4fefed5bc044bc88c
  patches:
    - drop_additional_flags.patch
    - do_not_run_ldconfig_on_install.patch
    - devendor_pybind11.patch
    - fix_pyd_windows_install.patch
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/librealsense-feedstock/issues/94
    - build_glsl_extensions_without_examples.patch
    # https://github.com/conda-forge/librealsense-feedstock/issues/66
    - use_cuda_toolkit.patch
    # clang 21: rs2_option(RS2_OPTION_COUNT + 10) is not a constant expression, as the value is out of range
    - fix_rs2_option_enum_range.patch
    # realsense-viewer without the examples, https://github.com/conda-forge/librealsense-feedstock/issues/49
    - build_graphical_tools_without_examples.patch
    # realsense2-gl with CUDA on Windows: CUDA frame-memory helpers not exported from realsense2.dll
    - export_cuda_frame_memory_on_windows.patch
    # realsense2(-gl).pc: use the real libdir, and link realsense2-gl in realsense2-gl.pc
    - fix_pkgconfig_files.patch

build:
  number: ${{ build_number }}
  # arm_variant_type is ignored for non-CUDA builds. Avoid building both the
  # sbsa and tegra variants in that case; only CUDA 12.9 supports tegra.
  skip:
    - target_platform == "linux-aarch64" and arm_variant_type == "tegra" and cuda_compiler_version != "12.9"

outputs:
  # Build and install the C++ library and Python bindings once. The librealsense
  # package inherits all staged files, matching the layout of the v0 recipe.
  - staging:
      name: librealsense-build
    build:
      script: build
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - ${{ compiler("c") }}
        - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
        - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - ${{ compiler("cuda") }}
            - if: target_platform == "linux-aarch64"
              then: arm-variant * ${{ arm_variant_type }}
        - cmake <4
        - ninja
        - if: linux
          then: libudev
      host:
        - python
        - if: linux
          then: libudev
        - libusb
        - pybind11
        - pybind11-abi
        - nlohmann_json
        - pybind11_json
        # realsense2-gl (BUILD_GLSL_EXTENSIONS)
        - glfw
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libgl-devel
            - libopengl-devel
            # GL/glu.h for realsense-viewer
            - libglu
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then:
            - cuda-version ==${{ cuda_compiler_version }}
            - cuda-cudart-dev
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - python

  - package:
      name: librealsense
    inherit: librealsense-build
    build:
      string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      files:
        exclude:
          # graphical tools, in realsense-viewer
          - "*bin/realsense-viewer*"
          - "*bin/rs-depth-quality*"
          - "*bin/rs-rosbag-inspector*"
    requirements:
      run:
        # realsense2Config.cmake calls find_dependency(nlohmann_json)
        - nlohmann_json
        - if: cuda_compiler_version != "None"
          then: __cuda
      run_exports:
        # See https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense/pull/3449
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librealsense", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - librealsense2/rs.hpp
            - librealsense2-gl/rs_processing_gl.hpp
          lib:
            - realsense2
            - realsense2-gl
          files:
            exists:
              - "**/cmake/realsense2/realsense2Config.cmake"
              - "**/cmake/realsense2-gl/realsense2-glConfig.cmake"
            not_exists:
              - "**/bin/realsense-viewer*"
      - requirements:
          run:
            - cmake-package-check
            - ${{ compiler('c') }}
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - if: unix
              then: pkg-config
        files:
          recipe:
            - test/pkgconfig_consumer.cpp
        script:
          - cmake-package-check realsense2 --targets realsense2::realsense2
          - cmake-package-check realsense2-gl --targets realsense2-gl::realsense2-gl
          - if: unix
            then:
              - ${CXX} test/pkgconfig_consumer.cpp -o pkgconfig_consumer $(pkg-config --cflags --libs realsense2-gl)

  - package:
      name: realsense-viewer
    inherit: librealsense-build
    build:
      string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
      files:
        include:
          - "*bin/realsense-viewer*"
          - "*bin/rs-depth-quality*"
          - "*bin/rs-rosbag-inspector*"
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librealsense", exact=True) }}
    about:
      summary: Graphical tools for Intel® RealSense™ cameras (realsense-viewer, rs-depth-quality, rs-rosbag-inspector).
      # bundles imgui, implot, glad (MIT), tinyfiledialogs (Zlib) and the Karla and Font Awesome fonts (OFL-1.1)
      license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib AND OFL-1.1
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          bin:
            - realsense-viewer
            - rs-depth-quality
            - rs-rosbag-inspector

  # Compatibility metapackage: the bindings are installed into librealsense,
  # as they were in the v0 recipe. Host numpy contributes its run export.
  - package:
      name: pyrealsense2
    build:
      string: ${{ build_prefix }}_py${{ python | version_to_buildstring }}_h${{ hash }}_${{ build_number }}
    requirements:
      host:
        - python
        - numpy
      run:
        - python
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("librealsense", exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - pyrealsense2

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense
  repository: https://github.com/IntelRealSense/librealsense
  # bundled third-party components are listed with their licenses in NOTICE.md:
  # easyloggingpp, rapidxml, glad (MIT), lz4 (BSD-2-Clause), rosbag/ros_comm (BSD-3-Clause)
  license: Apache-2.0 AND MIT AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE.md
  summary: Cross-platform library for Intel® RealSense™ depth and tracking cameras.
  description: |
    This feedstock packages the C++ library `librealsense` (including the
    `realsense2-gl` GLSL extension module), the Python library `pyrealsense2`,
    and `realsense-viewer`. The `realsense-viewer` package contains the graphical
    tools `realsense-viewer`, `rs-depth-quality` and `rs-rosbag-inspector`; the
    command-line tools (`rs-enumerate-devices`, `rs-fw-update`, ...) stay in
    `librealsense`. The packages are built enabling the `FORCE_RSUSB_BACKEND`
    CMake option, and they are available for all Linux and macOS platforms
    supported by conda-forge, including `linux-aarch64` for Nvidia Jetson boards.
    CUDA-enabled packages should be selected automatically on CUDA-capable
    platforms. Use `librealsense=*=*cuda*` to force a CUDA build or
    `librealsense=*=*cpu*` to force a CPU-only build.

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - traversaro
